title: CompArt: Operationalizing Aesthetic Alignment in Text-to-Image Generation via Principles of Art
abstract: arXiv:2503.12018v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Text-to-Image (T2I) diffusion models have made rapid progress on semantic alignment (generating what is described in the prompt), yet users still lack reliable control over aesthetic composition (how visual elements are put together). Prior work often treats aesthetics as a single, preference-driven notion (e.g., "high quality", "detailed", "breathtaking"), which does not map cleanly to compositional intent.   We propose Aesthetic Alignment: aligning generated images to explicit, user-specified compositional constraints. We operationalize these constraints using the Principles of Art (PoA)-e.g., Balance, Rhythm, and Emphasis-commonly used in art education to describe composition. To support this task, we introduce CompArt, a dataset of 80,032 WikiArt images augmented with captions and PoA analyses produced by a multimodal LLM under structured prompting. translated_title: CompArt：通过艺术原理实现文生图中的美学对齐
translated_abstract: 文生图扩散模型在语义对齐（生成提示词中描述的内容）方面取得了快速进展，但用户仍然缺乏对美学构图（视觉元素如何组合在一起）的可靠控制。先前的工作通常将美学视为单一的、由偏好驱动的概念（例如“高质量”、“细节丰富”、“令人惊叹”），这无法清晰地映射到构图意图上。我们提出了美学对齐这一任务：将生成的图像与明确的、用户指定的构图约束对齐。我们利用艺术原理来操作化这些约束，例如平衡、节奏和强调，这些原理在艺术教育中常用于描述构图。为支持这一任务，我们引入了CompArt数据集，该数据集包含80,032张WikiArt图像，并附有由多模态大语言模型在结构化提示下生成的描述和艺术原理分析。我们进一步提出了ArtDapter，一个轻量级且解耦的适配器……
tldr: 该论文提出CompArt数据集与ArtDapter适配器，利用艺术原理（平衡、节奏、强调等）将文生图模型与用户明确指定的美学构图约束对齐，实现对图像构图的可控生成。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CompArt, a dataset of 80,032 WikiArt images with PoA analyses, and ArtDapter, a lightweight disentangled adapter, to align text-to-image models with explicit user-specified aesthetic compositional constraints via Principles of Art such as Balance, Rhythm, and Emphasis.
